title: Spicy Thai Chickpea Wrap
description: A fusion twist on traditional Thai cuisine with the addition of warm, creamy chickpeas and crispy falafel. Perfect for a flavorful and filling snack.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the Thai Red Curry Paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked chickpeas and stir to combine with the curry paste.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Warm the naan breads by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the chickpea mixture onto the naan breads, followed by a piece of falafel and a sprinkle of cilantro.
